name: Arc B580 (Battlemage)
notes: Estimated - verify on hardware. Battlemage (BMG non-G31) reports percent-shaped volt/PL/TL controls at the native boundary; the UI displays those as mV/W/°C without routing them through Alchemist watt/C extended paths. vramMemSpeedLimit is an absolute whole-MHz value (2375 MHz stock); vfCurve R/W supported; gpuLock NOT supported; fan canControl=true. extendedRanges=false: the bundled 2023 IGCL runtime is Alchemist-era and does not apply to Battlemage. M17c: pciSubsysVendorId 32902 (0x8086 - the Intel LE decode) so the mock exercises the 'Intel (Limited Edition)' AIB row; no pciSubsysId (the variant is unknown on this estimated fixture).
